name: Nanakase Shikiko
source:
Shikiko is Tatsuki’s mother. She’s a kind-hearted girl who tries to look after her family, she also loves plants and is very green fingered; her room is full of plants. However, Shikiko has a fair amount of secrets with her as well; for some reason, she can't get close to fire nor touch meat.

On the night of shooting stars, she gets her wish to become young again.
translation:
Shikiko is Tatsuki’s mother. She’s a kind-hearted girl who tries to look after her family, she also loves plants and is very green fingered; her room is full of plants. However, Shikiko has a fair amount of secrets with her as well; for some reason, she can't get close to fire nor touch meat.

On the night of shooting stars, she gets her wish to become young again.
